observations: A heavy-duty industrial sewing machine on a metal table with a foot pedal.
The machine is light blue/grey with a green stripe and some text on the front panel.
The table has a white top and metal legs, showing signs of wear and chipped paint.
A red foot pedal is visible on the floor, connected by a black cord.
A control box with red and green buttons is mounted on the table.
The background is a plain grey wall with a light switch and a window with a curtain.
Text overlay: 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIOYE BALIKIS'.

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical damage or wear in the internal components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, bobbin area, and motor housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential internal wear

risks.proof: Close-up of the power cord, plug, and control box wiring.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with the foot pedal.
Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, bobbin area, and motor.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as an industrial sewing machine, but the seller's claim of working condition cannot be verified from the photo alone. Hidden risks include mechanical failure, internal wear, and electrical issues. Proof is needed to assess functionality and condition before pricing.
